title: Divided stars of Chehel Sotoun, Isfahan
subtitle: Chehel Sotoun Palace, Isfahan, Iran

given.O: The centre of a four-pointed star, at the crossing of the mirrors.

construction.note: The finished design was read from Wichmann’s OR1 drawing. The drawing gives no steps. The complete construction is shared with the Ismail shrine tutorial. Turning the source frame by90° gives the same mesh and kite proportions.
construction.changes: Brown bevel facets are removed. The7pt bands are represented by their centre lines. The steps, order and named points are ours. The colours retain the diagram’s classes and are illustrative. The olive six-stars use a two-by-two colour repeat, larger than the geometric repeat. The olive six-stars use a two-by-two colour repeat, larger than the geometric repeat. The olive six-stars use a two-by-two colour repeat, larger than the geometric repeat. steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A. Keep this compass size for the next steps.
Draw a circle with centre A through O. Draw a circle with centre G through O, where the line crosses the first circle on the left.
Draw a vertical line through O. It crosses the first circle at D and K. Draw a circle with centre D through O. Draw a circle with centre K through O.
Draw a straight line through B and H, C and J, E and L, and F and M. B, C, E, F, H, J, L and M are where the four new circles cross the first circle. The first circle is now cut into twelve.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: The four circles cross the first circle at B, C, E, F, H, J, L and M.

steps.text: Draw the lines through O that halve angles AOB, BOC and COD. Draw a line through O at 90° to each new line. The circle’s twelve points on these lines are S1 to S12, counted round it.

steps.text: Draw the four triangles.

steps.text: The first circle crosses the line at 45° from OA at P1, above O. Draw a circle with centre O and opening AE. It crosses that line at P2, above O. Draw vertical lines through P1 and P2. They cross the horizontal line at N1 and N2.
Draw a circle with centre N1 through O. It crosses the horizontal line again at N3, right of N1. Draw a circle with centre N2 through O. It crosses that line again at N4, right of N2.

Draw a circle with centre N3 and opening from O to N4. It crosses the horizontal line at N5, right of N3. Draw a circle with centre N5 and opening from O to N3. It crosses that line at N6, right of N5.
Draw a circle with centre O through N6. It crosses the horizontal and vertical lines at T1 to T4, counted round it. Draw a straight line through T1 and T2, T2 and T3, T3 and T4, and T4 and T1.
